decisions.reason: Because it builds directly on established burner and radiant-heater knowledge, the firm can assimilate early feedback and improve the component, but its non-flagship and limited website presence leave moderate withdrawal risk.

As a flagship electric infrared panel line with its own page and a direct fit with the firm's shift toward electric lower-carbon heating, it leverages related heating knowledge and in-house R&D, making near-term withdrawal very unlikely.

Its electric halogen infrared technology is adjacent to the firm's established heating systems and the own-page presence supports learning, but the withdrawal of the similar electric infrared hall heater and its non-flagship status leave moderate risk.

The hydrogen-capable gas dark infrared heater aligns with the firm's lower-carbon direction and builds on deep gas-infrared knowledge, while the real-world pilot provides ongoing learning, so it is very likely to be kept.
